The '''Planetary Trade Director''' was an elected official whose job it was to ensure fair trade for people on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] occupied the planet in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Planetary Trade Director [[Markren Pellias]] tried to stand up for his people, who were being forcibly conscripted to serve the Empire, but Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Naem Yrros|Yrros]] told him that the people were being adequately compensated.
